title: Weak Epp solution via normalized tensor branches
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings with a ring map A\to B. Let K,L,H be fields and suppose given compatible algebra structures A\to K\to L, A\to B\to L, and A\to K\to H [def-pc-field-extension]. Put T=(L\otimes_K H)/\sqrt{(0)}, where the quotient kills every nilpotent element [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Put A_H equal to the integral closure of A in H and B_H equal to the integral closure of B in T [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The canonical map H\to T, h\mapsto 1\otimes h followed by reduction, restricts to f:A_H\to B_H. Define IsEppWeakSolution(A,B,K,L,H) to mean that H/K is finite-dimensional and, for every maximal ideal q of B_H, the contraction n=f^{-1}(q) is maximal, both (A_H)_n and (B_H)_q are discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and the images of n and q generate the same ideal of (B_H)_q. For an injective local map of DVRs A\to B with fraction fields K\subseteq L, this is the weak-solution condition: every normalized local branch has ramification index one. No residue separability or stability under further extensions is required.
